_readme: Add a company by appending an object to `companies`. `cebeTicker` = ticker used by https://cebetracker.io/api/v1/companies.json (balance-sheet source). `quote` = Yahoo Finance symbol for the stock price used in market cap and mNAV (e.g. MSTR, ASST, 3350.T). `currency` = currency of that quote; non-USD quotes are converted with Yahoo FX (e.g. JPY=X). `display_quote` = optional Yahoo symbol shown in the Stock price cell (e.g. MPJPY). It does not change market cap, mNAV, or residual NAV. The cell also shows `quote`'s latest regular-session close. If `display_quote` fails, the cell shows `quote` and a note. `manual` = optional overrides used when the CEBE feed lacks a company or you want to pin a value from a filing (btc_holdings, debt_usd, preferred_usd, cash_usd, strc_holdings_usd, basic_shares, diluted_shares, source, as_of). Manual values WIN over the feed, so remove them once stale. `share_count` = optional basic-share override from a filing (`basic_shares`, `as_of`, `source`, `url`, optional `cash_spent_jpy`). It replaces CEBE's basic shares only while `as_of` is newer than CEBE's `as_of`. When CEBE's date moves past it, the feed is used again, including cash. `cash_spent_jpy` is cash spent on that filing, converted at the live USD/JPY rate: it is subtracted from CEBE cash and added to CEBE net claims, because residual NAV subtracts net claims. Market cap, basic mNAV, EV mNAV, residual NAV/share, the computed CEBE mNAV, shares outstanding, and Δ Shares all use the override count. CEBE Tracker's own published mNAV does not. `filings` = optional freshness check. Figures stay on the CEBE/manual values. `filings.source` `sec` with `filings.cik` (10-digit CIK) records the latest 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-Q/A, 10-K, or 10-K/A from EDGAR. Optional `filings.ticker` overrides `ticker` when the EDGAR symbol differs. A legacy `sec_cik` (and optional `sec_ticker`) still selects the SEC check. `filings.source` `metaplanet` (or `tdnet`) reads Metaplanet's TDnet disclosure list at `filings.url`, default https://metaplanet.jp/en/shareholders/disclosures. Metaplanet does not file with the SEC.

share_count.source: Outstanding shares as of 2026-10-14: 1,290,274,296 = issued 1,364,282,624 − treasury 74,008,328. Sep 30, 2026 (TDnet 140120261001544425, https://metaplanet.jp/disclosure-pdf/140120261001544425.pdf): issued excluding treasury 1,364,255,696 and treasury 26,928, so issued is 1,364,282,624. Oct 14, 2026 ToSTNeT-3 buyback (TDnet 140120261014550251, https://metaplanet.jp/disclosure-pdf/140120261014550251.pdf): 73,981,400 shares at ¥261, held as treasury and not cancelled. Treasury 26,928 + 73,981,400 = 74,008,328. The Oct 23, 2026 notice (TDnet 140120261023555451, https://metaplanet.jp/disclosure-pdf/140120261023555451.pdf) deducts 739,814 voting rights for those treasury shares.
